data.title: B-complex vitamins (riboflavin, niacin, pyridoxine, biotin, folic acid, B12)
data.category: More from Khopkar · Vitamins & trace elements
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Vitamins & trace elements_

**Class:** Water-soluble vitamins

## Mechanism of action
- Coenzymes in energy metabolism (B2, B3), amino acid metabolism (B6), carboxylation (biotin), one-carbon and DNA synthesis (folate, B12)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Riboflavin (B2) deficiency: angular cheilitis, glossitis (magenta tongue), seborrhoeic-like dermatitis, scrotal dermatitis
- Niacin (B3) deficiency — pellagra: photosensitive dermatitis (Casal necklace), diarrhoea, dementia; seen with alcoholism, isoniazid, carcinoid, Hartnup disease — treat with nicotinamide (see nicotinamide post)
- Pyridoxine (B6): prevent isoniazid neuropathy; deficiency causes seborrhoeic-like dermatitis, cheilitis
- Biotin: biotinidase/holocarboxylase deficiency (periorificial dermatitis, alopecia); popular for brittle nails (2.5 mg/day — limited evidence)
- Folic acid: with methotrexate; megaloblastic anaemia; pregnancy
- B12 (cyanocobalamin/methylcobalamin): pernicious anaemia, hyperpigmentation of knuckles and nails, glossitis; neuropathy

## Dose & formulations
- Riboflavin 5–10 mg/day; nicotinamide 100 mg every 6 h for pellagra; pyridoxine 10–25 mg with INH; biotin 2.5–5 mg/day; folic acid 1–5 mg/day; B12 1000 µg IM daily × 1 week, then weekly, then monthly (deficiency)

## Adverse effects
- Nicotinic acid (not nicotinamide): flushing, pruritus, hepatotoxicity, acanthosis nigricans
- High-dose B6: sensory neuropathy; B12 injections: acneiform eruption, rosacea flare
- Biotin interferes with laboratory immunoassays (thyroid, troponin) — stop 2–3 days before tests

## Contraindications
- Folic acid alone in B12 deficiency (corrects anaemia, neuropathy progresses)

## Drug interactions
- Isoniazid/penicillamine deplete B6; methotrexate/co-trimoxazole antagonise folate

## Pregnancy & lactation
Folic acid 400 µg–5 mg recommended in pregnancy.

## Viva points
- Pellagra 4 Ds (dermatitis, diarrhoea, dementia, death); Casal necklace
- B12 deficiency → knuckle hyperpigmentation
- Biotin interferes with lab tests

_Sources: Khopkar (Water-soluble vitamins — riboflavin, niacin, biotin, folic acid); Wolverton 4e ch.40. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
